Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing street, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: center; parking: lot
- commercial building at center, 1 story, brick, glass, pitched roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: grass strip, hedge
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait image — one single frame. Expand the SAME
scene naturally above (sky) and below (street/pavement) — this is canvas
extension of one photograph, not additional panels. Do not stretch or distort
the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. A 2005 gas station — big multi-island canopy, card readers at every pump, LED price sign, and a convenience store doing most of the business.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- wide multi-island canopy with branded fascia lighting
- automated car wash tunnel beside the lot
- price sign showing gas around $2.30
- main sign: "Phillips 66" branded gas station — Phillips 66 pole sign with price display and Phillips 66 colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'ANY SIZE FOUNTAIN DRINK 99¢', 'CAR WASH $6'
- a propane exchange cage by the storefront
- ribbon magnets on the door of the service office
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles; sidewalks busy, driving lanes clear.
- a driver self-serving at the pump
- a woman inserting her card at the pump reader
- a man in cargo shorts talking on a flip phone
Clothing: men in graphic tees, frosted tips hair; women in chunky highlights, trucker hats. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — the driving lanes stay empty of pedestrians. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 3 period vehicles, all different:
- 2002-2007 Jeep Liberty — round-headlight compact SUV — silver
- 2005-2010 Chevrolet Cobalt — compact economy sedan — gold
- 2003-2009 Hummer H2 — massive military-styled SUV — black
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2005.
All vehicles obey normal US right-hand traffic flow — parked parallel to the curb, each facing the same direction as its adjacent lane. Nothing sideways, diagonal, or against traffic.
At least one full driving lane in each direction stays clear of parked vehicles, meters, and curb infrastructure — through traffic is never blocked.
One of these vehicles is parked at the pump island with its driver standing beside it refueling.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the LEFT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

TREES
- deciduous tree at right: maturing tree
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
